title: SOC2/ISO evidence buckets and sprint commit matrix
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Produce an operational model that buckets compliance evidence (SOC2 & ISO) by ownership and lifecycle stage, and translate that into a sprint-level commit matrix with named owners and acceptance criteria. Background: Multiple compliance runs showed gaps where evidence collection was ad-hoc and depended on tribal knowledge. This ticket standardizes buckets (config, access, audit, processes, vendor attestations) and creates a consumable sprint commit matrix that engineering, security, and product teams can follow for the next 2 quarters. Scope: - Define evidence buckets and canonical artifact locations - Map each evidence item to an owner, retention policy, and automation opportunity - Create sprint-level commits (who does what in which cycle) for Q1 deliverables and fast-follow backlog for Q2 - Surface gaps that require infra or console changes and create follow-up ENG tickets Out of scope: generating all artifacts; this ticket creates the matrix and accompanying runbook to guide work.
acceptance_criteria: A canonical list of evidence buckets exists and is approved by Security and Legal
A sprint commit matrix with per-item owner, due date, and acceptance checks is published in Confluence
All items classified as automation candidates have a follow-up ENG ticket or are scheduled into a sprint
PM/Trust lead sign-off obtained and communicated to stakeholders

evidence_buckets: Access Controls: IAM policies, Admin role lists, SSO/SAML configuration export (owner: IAM team)
Audit Logs: Retention policy, ingestion pipeline health, sample logs for critical actions (owner: Observability)
Change Controls: Release notes, change approvals, config diffs for security-sensitive services (owner: Platform PM)
Process Evidence: Incident runbooks, onboarding checklists, training attestations (owner: People Ops)
Vendor/Third-party: Signed attestations, SOC reports from infra providers (owner: Procurement)
Encryption & KMS: KMS configuration, key rotation proofs, policy documents (owner: Security)
Data Flow Diagrams: Updated diagrams for regulated data paths and storage (owner: Architecture)
sprint_commit_matrix_summary: Matrix published with rows = evidence items, columns = sprint (2025-W03..W10), owner, acceptance checklist, automation flag, and dependency. First sprint focuses on audit logs retention proof, SSO metadata export, and two process artifacts. Owners are named and escalation contacts are included.
risk_and_blockers: Audit log retention requires a small change to platform retention policy; ENG prioritization required
SSO/SAML metadata export varies by IdP tenant; support for customer tenants may require a new export tool
Legal needs more time to validate vendor attestations; potential schedule slip if third-party responses are delayed
